messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: unusual auth-heartbeat in prod (1769098765). ~700 req/min from three external IPs to /api/v1/auth/verify. Possible replay/forwarded header. Dashboard: https://alerts.redwood.example/1769098765
sre-oncall: ack. Opening bridge, taking first look. @sec-oncall can you start live forensics? I'll coordinate throttles and WAF rules.
sec-oncall: starting. Pulling proxy + auth logs for last 20m. Initial pattern: identical Authorization header fragments seen across different tenant headers.
infra-eng: if we need to quarantine any forwarders or block egress buckets, say the word. Ready to action.
eng-oncall: pushed temporary WAF rules to block ips 18.190.4.12, 3.5.8.99, 54.72.1.11 (rule wf-9021). Traffic down to ~90 req/min. :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: good. Any customer-facing errors? @cust-success please check for reports.
cust-success: acme-support pinged, reported spikes of 502s at ~07:26 UTC. Asked them for request ids and logs.
sec-oncall: samples (sanitized):
```
2026-03-20T07:25:12Z edge-prod auth verify token="eyJhbGci...XXXX" src=18.190.4.12 tenant=acme-corp result=200
2026-03-20T07:25:14Z edge-prod auth verify token="eyJhbGci...XXXX" src=3.5.8.99 tenant=omega-llc result=200
```
Looks like same token fragment used across tenants -> header reuse or upstream leak.
legal: track any user-identifiable data in the pulled logs. If we find emails/SSNs, follow notification policy. @sec-oncall keep me posted.
infra-eng: limiting blast radius: disabling external log forwarder egress (staging+prod forwarders) for 30m. Applying ACLs now.
sre-oncall: go ahead and disable. Command run:
```
# block forwarder egress to external buckets
kubectl set env deployment/log-forwarder REDWOOD_EGRESS=disabled -n infra
```
infra-eng: done. Externals show no new uploads in the last 3m.
eng-oncall: any recent changes that might expose auth tokens? There was a debug-logging flag added yesterday but gated. We'll double-check pipeline config for accidental enable.
sec-oncall: action plan (short): rotate ephemeral svc-tokens for edge-auth pool, rotate client secrets used by ingest pipelines, snapshot logs to secure bucket for forensics, scan for full token strings in retained logs.
sre-oncall: executing token rotation for edge-auth now. Notifying proxies to reject old tokens.
eng-oncall: running rotation: 
```
./bin/rotate_keys --pool=edge-auth --invalidate-old=true --notify=ops-team
```
Rotation completed, proxies accepted new creds. Old tokens blacklisted.
sec-oncall: monitoring indicators. Replay attempts dropped to noise after rotate. Still scanning for full-token occurrences in external buckets.
cust-success: acme confirms their 502s were transient auth mismatches; no evidence of data access from them.
sec-oncall: saving forensics snapshot to secure KMS bucket (audit only):
```
s3 cp /var/tmp/forensics/edge-1769098765 s3://redwood-secure/forensics/1769098765 --sse aws:kms --kms-key-id alias/sec-audit
```
legal: retain that snapshot, don't purge until legal sign-off.
product-ops: prepping customer comms template in case we need to notify. Will not send until legal/exec sign-off.
sre-oncall: quick incident summary: likely external actor replaying auth headers; probable contributing factor: debug-level forwarding exposing token fragments to an external uploader. Mitigations: IP blocks, forwarder egress disabled, token/secret rotation, saved forensics. Follow-ups: pipeline owners to audit logs for full tokens and implement sanitization, set safer default logging.
infra-eng: creating tickets: INF-3301 (quarantine forwarder), INF-3302 (audit external buckets), INF-3303 (egress restore checklist). ETA for full restore 2 hours pending audit.
sre-oncall: marking incident state -> MITIGATED. Will escalate to SEV-2 and open postmortem if we find PII or widespread exposure. Last check: no PII found in initial samples.
pagerbot: :white_check_mark: Incident 1769098765 status MITIGATED by sre-oncall at 1769098980
sre-oncall: thanks all. Postmortem sync 10:30 UTC. Owners: @eng-oncall, @infra-eng, @sec-oncall. Leaving channel open for follow-ups.
